title: Recover Empty AGVs That Lost Tasks After RMS Restart (Remove/Re-add AGVs Twice)
summary: If empty AGVs lose their tasks after an RMS restart, stop RMS, remove and re-add the affected empty AGVs without totes twice, verify each AGV is in the "szonestaging" state on the HMI, press E-stop again when ready, then resume RMS.
when_to_use: Use when empty AGVs have lost their tasks because the RMS was restarted, and the recovery guidance calls for removing and re-adding the AGVs twice and confirming "szonestaging" before resuming RMS.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the RMS stop/resume and the RMS Tote API Controls remove/re-add cycle, and verify AGV state on the HMI before resuming RMS.
safety_notes: Do not resume RMS until the affected AGVs are confirmed in the "szonestaging" state on the HMI.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI / lane UI (hospital_hmi) used to reference AGV state

system_preconditions: The issue condition matches: empty AGVs have lost their tasks because the RMS was restarted.

visual_references.description: RMS screen used during fault recovery showing the AGV add flow and the "szonestaging" verification requirement for recovery.
Example RMS/HMI fault recovery screen context showing E-stop RMS and remove/add via API controls as part of recovery flows.

steps.title: E-stop RMS on the RMS / fleet status UI
steps.purpose: Stop RMS before performing the remove/re-add recovery cycle for empty AGVs that lost tasks after an RMS restart.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), press the E-stop for RMS.
steps.expected_result: RMS is in an E-stopped state on the RMS / fleet status UI.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS E-stop control is engaged/active on the RMS / fleet status UI.
steps.failure_condition: RMS is not stopped (E-stop does not engage) or the UI does not reflect an E-stopped state.
stop_or_escalate_if: If RMS E-stop cannot be engaged, stop and escalate.

steps.title: Remove and re-add empty AGVs without totes twice using Tote API Controls
steps.purpose: Restore task assignment for empty AGVs that lost tasks after RMS restart by performing the required remove/re-add cycle twice.
steps.instruction: Using the Tote API Controls flow within the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), remove and re-add the affected empty AGVs without totes twice.
steps.expected_result: Each affected empty AGV has been removed and re-added twice via the RMS Tote API Controls flow.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGVs proceed through the expected post-add state progression (next step will verify "szonestaging").
steps.failure_condition: The AGVs do not progress as expected after the remove/re-add cycle, or the remove/re-add operation cannot be completed.

actions.label: Remove/re-add AGVs twice (no totes)
actions.exact_action: Remove and re-add AGVs without totes twice. (See "Tote API Controls" on page 26.)

stop_or_escalate_if: If the remove/re-add cycle cannot be completed twice, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.3: AGVS LOST TASKS... 2. Remove and re-add AGVs without totes twice. (See "Tote API Controls" on page 26.)

steps.title: Verify AGVs are in "szonestaging" on the HMI
steps.purpose: Ensure the required AGV state is achieved before pressing E-stop again and resuming RMS.
steps.instruction: If the system needs to be restarted, verify on the HMI (hospital_hmi) that the affected AGVs are in the "szonestaging" state by referencing the AGV state/value on the HMI.
steps.expected_result: The affected empty AGVs show AGV status/state value "szonestaging" on the HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV status is "szonestaging" for the affected empty AGVs.
steps.failure_condition: Any affected empty AGV is not in "szonestaging" state.

actions.label: Check AGV state = szonestaging
actions.exact_action: Verify AGV status is "szonestaging". (Reference AGV state on HMI.)

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if AGVs cannot be brought to "szonestaging".

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.3: AGVS LOST TASKS... 3. If the system needs to be restarted, make sure the AGVs are in the "szonestaging" state. (Reference AGV state on the HMI.)

steps.title: Press E-stop again when ready to resume
steps.purpose: Complete the required stop/resume sequence after the AGVs are confirmed in "szonestaging".
steps.instruction: When the affected empty AGVs are confirmed in "szonestaging" on the HMI, press the E-stop again on the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) when ready to resume.
steps.expected_result: The RMS E-stop control is pressed again (as indicated by the RMS / fleet status UI).
steps.healthy_condition: E-stop again action is accepted and the system is ready for RMS resumption.
steps.failure_condition: E-stop again cannot be performed or RMS does not proceed to the resume-ready state.

actions.label: Press E-stop again
actions.exact_action: Press the E-stop again when ready to resume.

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not resume RMS until AGVs are confirmed in "szonestaging" state on the HMI.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.3: AGVS LOST TASKS... 4. Press the E-stop again when ready to resume.

steps.title: Resume RMS on the RMS / fleet status UI
steps.purpose: Restart RMS operations after the recovery cycle and state verification.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), resume RMS.
steps.expected_result: RMS resumes/starts successfully on the RMS / fleet status UI.
steps.healthy_condition: RMS is resumed and the affected empty AGVs are no longer in the lost-task condition.
steps.failure_condition: Lost-task condition persists after resuming RMS.

actions.label: Resume RMS
actions.exact_action: Resume RMS. (See "Starting the System" on page 65.)

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the lost-task condition persists after the twice remove/re-add process.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.3: AGVS LOST TASKS... 5. Resume RMS. (See "Starting the System" on page 65.)

success_criteria: RMS is resumed on the RMS / fleet status UI.
Affected empty AGVs are no longer in the lost-task condition after the remove/re-add cycle and "szonestaging" verification.
healthy_conditions: Affected empty AGVs show AGV status/state value "szonestaging" on the HMI.
RMS is resumed/started on the RMS / fleet status UI.
failure_conditions: Any affected empty AGV cannot be brought to "szonestaging".
Lost-task condition persists after the twice remove/re-add process and RMS resumption.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if AGVs cannot be brought to "szonestaging" or if the lost-task condition persists after the twice remove/re-add process.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: 5.8.2.3: AGVS LOST TASKS... 1. E-stop RMS. 2. Remove and re-add AGVs without totes twice. 3. If the system needs to be restarted, make sure the AGVs are in the "szonestaging" state. 4. Press the E-stop again when ready to resume. 5. Resume RMS. NOTE: The best practice is to shut down and restart to ensure everything is in sync.

missing_details: The packet does not provide a specific HMI artifact that explicitly shows the "szonestaging" value for AGVs; step 3 relies on the manual instruction to reference AGV state on the HMI.
